pages.title: Compare what Parkland already includes.
pages.description: Before choosing a charter, cyber charter, or alternative school, see how Parkland's academics, virtual flexibility, activities, support services, and local community compare.

faq.question: How should families use this comparison?
faq.answer: Use it as a source-backed starting point, then confirm current program details directly with each school before making an enrollment decision.

faq.question: Is this an anti-charter comparison?
faq.answer: No. The rows compare public facts, numbers, services, flexibility, accountability, and local connection without saying charter schools are bad.
